extraction_notes: Main-article extract only. Values for Co/C12A7:e−, Co–Mo/CeO2, LaCoSi, Co3Mo3N, Co/MgO and other comparison catalysts in Figure 1a/text were treated as literature/reference comparison values and were not extracted, except Co/CeN bulk. Approximate values from Figure 1b,c,d are read from plotted points and marked with qualifier '~'. Supporting Information figures/tables (S1–S30, Tables S1–S5) were cited but not provided in the input and therefore not extracted.
